title: System Risk Evaluation
briefing: Select all potential risk factors present in the following scenario: A remote login was attempted using default credentials.

feedback.Use of default credentials: Correct. Default credentials are a serious vulnerability and commonly exploited by attackers.
feedback.Remote access: Correct. Remote access increases the attack surface and requires strong controls to prevent unauthorized entry.
feedback.Multifactor authentication: Incorrect. Multifactor authentication is a protective control, not a risk factor in this scenario.
